items.title: Tyson Foods cuts fiscal 2026 profit forecast again on beef losses

items.summary: Tyson Foods updated its fiscal 2026 outlook Thursday. Investors aren’t too pleased.

items.title: 🔎 Under the Radar: Tyson Stock Plunges as Beef Business Weighs on Outlook
items.summary: Shares of Tyson Foods slumped 7% Thursday after the meatpacker said it expects steeper losses in its beef business for the fiscal year.  With its fiscal year ending this month, the company now says it plans to lose between $625 million and $775 million in its beef business.  A cattle shortage in the U.S. is driving up beef prices and squeezing meatpacker’s profits.

items.title: Tyson Foods Cuts Revenue Guidance, Citing Cattle Pressure
items.summary: The company said that it expects revenue in fiscal 2026 to rise by 1.5% to 2%, down from a previous range of 2.5% to 3.5%.
